title: Church music, Mahalia Jackson and not mixing gospel with club work
summary: Humes dislikes modern church music that sounds like rock and roll. She admires Marion Williams and met Mahalia Jackson in Chicago around 1939-40, and does not think church songs belong in club work.

story.theme_name: Church, faith and religion in a musician's life
story.community_name: Church, faith and jazz: the sacred and the secular
